field_text_formatted.value: With the secret of a consumer set up for Simple OAuth in DRUXT_NODE_PREVIEW_CLIENT_SECRET, the module adds its target to Drupal whenever Nuxt starts up, and removes it when the server stops. A target with token on reads with a token instead, and with Druxt's API proxy on, that request stays on the frontend's origin, so Drupal's CORS doesn't need changing for it.
